title: Source Hydrator: Applications hydrating into the repository root stop working

detection.reason: hydratorPath is projected as the Application's spec.sourceHydrator.syncSource.path, and as an empty string when the hydrator is configured without a path

quote: Source hydration (with Source Hydrator) now requires that every application specify a non-root path. Using the repository root (for example, "" or ".") is no longer supported.
remediation: Set `spec.sourceHydrator.syncSource.path` to a subdirectory (for example `apps/guestbook`) on each Application named here before upgrading, then delete stale hydration output left at the repository root.
verifyCommand: kubectl get applications -A -o json | jq -r '.items[] | select(.spec.sourceHydrator != null) | select((.spec.sourceHydrator.syncSource.path // "") | test("^[./]*$")) | .metadata.namespace + "/" + .metadata.name' # names printed hydrate into the repository root

title: `.argocd-source.yaml` can now pin the Kustomize version

detection.reason: `.argocd-source.yaml` lives in the repository, not on the cluster. The hint names every Application Argo CD renders through Kustomize (its status source type).

quote: Starting with Argo CD v3.2, you can now set the Kustomize version in the `.argocd-source.yaml` file like this:
remediation: If a repository already carries `kustomize.version` in `.argocd-source.yaml`, it now takes effect — make sure that version is registered under `kustomize.versions` in argocd-cm, or rendering fails.
verifyCommand: kubectl get applications -A -o json | jq -r '.items[] | select(.status.sourceType == "Kustomize" or ([.status.sourceTypes[]?] | index("Kustomize"))) | .metadata.namespace + "/" + .metadata.name' # Applications printed render through Kustomize — check whether their source path has a .argocd-source*.yaml naming a kustomize version

title: CronJobs now carry health — Applications may turn Degraded

detection.reason: which CronJobs an Application manages is not related in the inventory; the hint names CronJobs that carry the Argo CD tracking annotation

quote: After the upgrade, Application's status may transition to `Degraded` depending on the CronJob health.
remediation: Decide per CronJob: accept the new health, override it via `resource.customizations.health.batch_CronJob` in argocd-cm, or annotate the CronJob `argocd.argoproj.io/ignore-healthcheck: "true"` to keep it out of the Application's aggregated health.
verifyCommand: kubectl get cronjobs -A -o json | jq -r '.items[] | select(.metadata.annotations["argocd.argoproj.io/tracking-id"] != null or .metadata.labels["app.kubernetes.io/instance"] != null) | .metadata.namespace + "/" + .metadata.name' # CronJobs printed are Argo CD managed and start contributing health at 3.2

title: ApplicationSet `status.resources` is capped at 5000 entries

detection.reason: the size of an ApplicationSet's status.resources list is not projected

quote: The `resources` field of the `status` resource of an ApplicationSet is now limited to 5000 elements by default. This is to prevent status bloat and exceeding etcd limits.
remediation: If an ApplicationSet generates more than 5000 Applications and your tooling reads `status.resources`, raise `applicationsetcontroller.status.max.resources.count` in argocd-cmd-params-cm or read the Applications directly.
verifyCommand: kubectl get applicationsets -A -o json | jq -r '.items[] | select(.status.resources[4999] != null) | .metadata.namespace + "/" + .metadata.name' # names printed already exceed 5000 generated Applications

title: Built-in health checks added for 23 resource kinds — Applications that deploy them can turn Degraded or Progressing

detection.reason: objects of these custom resource kinds, and their current health, are not collected; the hint names the installed CRDs whose group and kind are on the list (group and kind are matched separately, so a CRD pairing a listed group with another listed group's kind is named too) (CronJob has its own rule)

quote: * datadoghq.com/DatadogMetric * CronJob * promoter.argoproj.io/ArgoCDCommitStatus * promoter.argoproj.io/ChangeTransferPolicy * promoter.argoproj.io/CommitStatus * promoter.argoproj.io/PromotionStrategy * promoter.argoproj.io/PullRequest * coralogix.com/Alert * coralogix.com/RecordingRuleGroupSet * projectcontour.io/ExtensionService * clickhouse-keeper.altinity.com/ClickHouseKeeperInstallation * clickhouse.altinity.com/ClickHouseInstallation * apps.3scale.net/APIManager * capabilities.3scale.net/ActiveDoc * capabilities.3scale.net/ApplicationAuth * capabilities.3scale.net/Application * capabilities.3scale.net/Backend * capabilities.3scale.net/CustomPolicyDefinition * capabilities.3scale.net/DeveloperAccount * capabilities.3scale.net/DeveloperUser * capabilities.3scale.net/OpenAPI * capabilities.3scale.net/Product * capabilities.3scale.net/ProxyConfigPromote * capabilities.3scale.net/Tenant
remediation: Objects of these kinds start counting toward their Application's health at this version: one the new check reads as Degraded or Progressing turns its Application Degraded or Progressing and holds later sync waves. Check the status of these objects in the Applications that deploy them before upgrading, or override a kind with `resource.customizations.health.<group>_<Kind>` in argocd-cm.
verifyCommand: kubectl get crd -o json | jq -r '.items[] | select(IN(.spec.group + "/" + .spec.names.kind; "datadoghq.com/DatadogMetric", "promoter.argoproj.io/ArgoCDCommitStatus", "promoter.argoproj.io/ChangeTransferPolicy", "promoter.argoproj.io/CommitStatus", "promoter.argoproj.io/PromotionStrategy", "promoter.argoproj.io/PullRequest", "coralogix.com/Alert", "coralogix.com/RecordingRuleGroupSet", "projectcontour.io/ExtensionService", "clickhouse-keeper.altinity.com/ClickHouseKeeperInstallation", "clickhouse.altinity.com/ClickHouseInstallation", "apps.3scale.net/APIManager", "capabilities.3scale.net/ActiveDoc", "capabilities.3scale.net/ApplicationAuth", "capabilities.3scale.net/Application", "capabilities.3scale.net/Backend", "capabilities.3scale.net/CustomPolicyDefinition", "capabilities.3scale.net/DeveloperAccount", "capabilities.3scale.net/DeveloperUser", "capabilities.3scale.net/OpenAPI", "capabilities.3scale.net/Product", "capabilities.3scale.net/ProxyConfigPromote", "capabilities.3scale.net/Tenant")) | .metadata.name' # CRDs printed gain an Argo CD health check at 3.2 — check the status of their objects in your Applications
